reddit.title: Introducing New Features for Enhanced Colony Management
reddit.body: We've made significant updates to how your colony communicates with you! Now, settlers display thought badges indicating their needs, and problem alerts stack up so you can address issues quickly. No more guesswork—your settlement will report itself. Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

posts: Exciting news! Your colony can now speak for itself with new thought badges and problem alerts. Check out the improvements that will help you manage your settlement more effectively: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

Say goodbye to silent colonies! With our latest updates, settlers now show their needs directly, and you'll receive alerts for any issues that arise. Learn more about these features here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

steam.title: New Communication Features in Provincia
steam.body: We've introduced exciting new features that allow your colony to communicate its needs and issues more clearly. Settlers now display badges for their needs, and problem alerts will help you address issues without searching the grid. Learn more about these updates and how they will enhance your gameplay: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back
